tools_metadata.description: Metadata documentation for all available tools in the storyboard generation agent

tools.name: list_tags
tools.function: List all available tags in the PixelHub system to understand what tags can be used for image searching
usage_guidelines: ALWAYS call this tool FIRST before searching for images
Use a high limit value (1000) to get all tags at once
Review the returned tags to find the most relevant ones for your search

limit.description: Number of tags per page. Use high value to get all tags at once

tags.name: Tag name
tags.count: Number of images with this tag

tools.name: search_images_by_tags
tools.function: Search for images by tags using relevance ranking with OR logic. Returns images matching any of the provided tags, sorted by number of matched tags
usage_guidelines: MUST call list_tags first to get available tags
Only use tags that exist in the system
Use multiple tags for better relevance ranking
Images are sorted by number of matched tags (most relevant first)

tags.description: List of tags to search for. MUST use tags from list_tags result

tags: List of all tags for this image

tools.name: extract_color_palette
tools.function: Extract the 4 dominant colors from an image URL. Useful for color consistency and palette matching
usage_guidelines: Provide a valid image URL (supports http/https)
Returns RGB and hex color codes
Can extract from both local files and remote URLs
Use for maintaining color consistency across generated images
Right before invoking this tool, print `PALETTE_URL: <url>` on its own line so downstream logic can double-check the target
When calling the tool, ensure the Action Input is ONLY the bare URL string (no JSON, no extra text)

image_url.description: URL of the image to analyze

outputs.format: Formatted text with RGB and hex color codes
outputs.structure:
Color 1: RGB(r, g, b) - Hex: #rrggbb
Color 2: RGB(r, g, b) - Hex: #rrggbb
...

tools.name: nanobanana_generate
tools.function: Generate images based on text prompts and reference image(s) using Google Gemini. Perfect for creating variations or modifications of existing images
usage_guidelines: Provide detailed and creative prompts
Can use single or multiple reference images
Supports both local file paths and URLs
Generated images are saved locally and optionally uploaded to COS
Use for image variations, modifications, or style transfers

prompt.description: Text description for image generation. Be creative and detailed!

input_image_paths.description: Path or URL to reference image, or list of paths/URLs for multiple images

upload_to_cos.description: Whether to upload the generated image to Tencent Cloud COS

outputs.description: URL of uploaded image (if COS enabled) or local file path

tools.example_usage: nanobanana_generate(prompt='Create a picture of my cat eating a nano-banana in a fancy restaurant', input_image_paths='path/to/cat.jpg', upload_to_cos=True)
dependencies: Optional: COS credentials (COS_SECRET_ID, COS_SECRET_KEY, COS_REGION, COS_BUCKET)

tools.name: midjourney_imagine
tools.function: Generate images using Midjourney AI. Synchronous operation that polls until completion. Generates 4 images in a 2x2 grid
usage_guidelines: Use Midjourney-style prompts with parameters (--ar 16:9, --v 6, etc.)
Operation is synchronous and may take 1-5 minutes
Generates 4 image variations in one task
Save the task_id from output for upscaling
Maximum poll time is 5 minutes

prompt.description: Prompt for image generation. Can include Midjourney parameters like --ar 16:9, --v 6, etc.

outputs.structure: Formatted text containing task ID, prompts, progress, and image URL. Use task_id for upscaling

tools.example_usage: midjourney_imagine(prompt='A beautiful sunset over the ocean --ar 16:9 --v 6')

tools.name: midjourney_upscale
tools.function: Upscale a specific image (1-4) from a completed Midjourney task. Synchronous operation that polls until completion
usage_guidelines: Requires a task_id from a completed imagine/variation/reroll task
Index must be between 1-4 (1=top-left, 2=top-right, 3=bottom-left, 4=bottom-right)
Operation is synchronous and may take 1-3 minutes
Use after midjourney_imagine to get high-resolution version

task_id.description: Task ID from a completed imagine/variation/reroll task

outputs.structure: Formatted text containing original task ID, upscale task ID, selected index, and upscaled image URL

tools.name: midjourney_generate_upscaled
tools.function: Run Midjourney imagine and upscale sequentially in a single call. Returns structured JSON with both task IDs and URLs.
usage_guidelines: Preferred way to generate storyboard frames: pass the final Midjourney prompt and optional index (defaults to 1)
Always format prompts as `<reference_url> <description + palette>` before calling
If you need a different crop, set `index` to 1-4; the tool validates the range
Falls back to separate midjourney_imagine / midjourney_upscale only when you need manual control
Output is JSON – parse fields like `imagine_task_id`, `upscale_task_id`, and `upscaled_image_url` for downstream steps

prompt.description: Midjourney prompt string in the required `<reference_url> <description>` format

index.description: Image index to upscale (1-4). Defaults to 1 if omitted.

outputs.structure: { "prompt": str, "upscale_index": int, "imagine_task_id": str, "imagine_image_url": str, "upscale_task_id": str, "upscaled_image_url": str, ... }

tools.name: check_image_distortion
tools.function: Run the MediaPipe-based distortion checker on a generated storyboard image to ensure hands, limbs, and faces look anatomically correct.
usage_guidelines: ALWAYS call immediately after each MidJourney upscale before moving to product replacement
Pass the storyboard image URL directly; the tool can also take local file paths or base64 data
If distortions are found, add the reported labels to the negative prompt list and retry
If all three attempts fail, pick the attempt with the fewest distortions and flag the beat for review

image_path.description: Storyboard image identifier: supports http(s) URLs, local file paths, or base64 strings (data URI or 'base64:' prefix).

outputs.description: Human-readable report with PASS/FAIL status, distortion details, and embedded JSON for parsing.

tools.name: remember
tools.function: Store a note or information for the current session. Useful for maintaining context across multiple operations
usage_guidelines: Use to store important information across conversation
Good for remembering user preferences, decisions, or interim results
Memory persists only for the current session
Use recall to retrieve stored notes

note.description: The note or information to store

outputs.format: stored (N total) - where N is the total number of stored notes

tools.example_usage: remember(note='User prefers warm color palettes with orange and red tones')

tools.name: recall
tools.function: Retrieve all notes stored in the current session
usage_guidelines: Use to retrieve previously stored information
Returns all notes stored with remember tool
Returns '(empty)' if no notes are stored

outputs.format: All stored notes separated by newlines, or '(empty)' if none

utilities.name: COSUploader
utilities.function: Utility class for uploading files to Tencent Cloud COS (Cloud Object Storage)
usage_guidelines: Not a LangChain tool - used internally by other tools
Automatically used by nanobanana_generate when upload_to_cos=True
Requires COS credentials to be configured
Supports uploading files and bytes data

methods.name: upload_file
methods.description: Upload a local file to COS

methods.name: file_exists
methods.description: Check if a file exists in COS

methods.name: get_file_url
methods.description: Get the public URL for a file in COS

required.PIXELHUB_API_URL: URL for PixelHub API (for image search)
required.MIDJOURNEY_PROXY_BASE_URL: Base URL for Midjourney proxy API

optional.COS_SECRET_ID: Tencent Cloud COS Secret ID (for file uploads)
optional.COS_SECRET_KEY: Tencent Cloud COS Secret Key (for file uploads)

common_errors.solution: Ensure required environment variables are configured
Check network connectivity and API service status
Always call list_tags first to get valid tags
Image generation can take 1-5 minutes. Wait for completion or check API status
Verify COS credentials and bucket permissions. Image will still be saved locally
